title: Sol Gubin; learning to tune drums from Jimmy Bertrand and Holland Harold
summary: Jones says he learned drum tuning from Bertrand and from Holland Harold, an Omaha drummer and teacher.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Learning your horn: teachers, lessons and fees

blocks.x: And of course Buddy Rich, if we can just review! In this new day of television and recordings and precisionists, a young lad came along who Buddy thought a great deal of. I'm sure you did too, how about Sol Gubin?

Sol is definitely a percussionist... When you say a percussionist, a guy that can play whatever it is and can tune these drums and what have you. I didn't know anything about tuning drums until I got with a saxophone

player's band. I didn't know nothing about tuning drums until I rubbed elbows with a Jimmy Bertrand. I didn't know nothing about tuning drums until I ran into the second greatest guy that I ever knew in my life, a fellow by the name of Holland Harold.
Drums, he played the whole bit. He taught.
Omaha, Nebraska. We all called him Tubby. My eyes was getting opened then. I would stand on the floor and look at all these peoples, you know, the Cuba Austin's and what have you.
